basic.name: Baneling Barrage
basic.description:
Launch 2 Banelings that deal 80~~0.04~~ damage to enemies they hit.

Stores up to 2 charges.

basic.name: Hunter Killer
basic.description: Summon a Hydralisk to attack a single target, dealing 71~~0.05~~ damage per second. The Hydralisk loses Health over 10 seconds, and has 500~~0.045~~ Health.

basic.name: Infested Drop
basic.description:
Bombard target area with a Zerg Drop Pod for 140~~0.04~~ damage. 

The pod spawns 2 Roachlings that deal 30~~0.04~~ damage per second and lose Health over 10 seconds.

heroic.name: Nydus Network
heroic.description:
Summon a Nydus Worm on Creep anywhere that Zagara has vision. Zagara can enter a Nydus Worm and travel to any other Nydus Worm by right-clicking near it. While inside a Nydus Worm, Zagara regenerates 10% Health and Mana per second.

Stores up to 2 charges. Maximum of 4 Nydus Worms at a time.

Passive: Creep spreads 15% farther. 
Passive: While on Creep, each Basic Attack reduces all of Zagara's cooldowns by 0.4 seconds.

heroic.name: Devouring Maw
heroic.description:
Summon a Devouring Maw that devours enemies for 4 seconds. Devoured enemies cannot fight and take 94~~0.04~~ damage per second.

Usable on Unstoppable enemies.

trait.name: Creep Tumor
trait.description:
Lay a Creep Tumor that generates Creep. While on Creep, Zagara moves 20% faster and her summons move 30% faster. Tumors lose Health over 250 seconds and reveal the surrounding area while active.

Stores up to 3 charges.

activable.name: Spell Shield - Disabled
activable.description:
Spell Shield is disabled and will not trigger.

Click this button to enable Spell Shield.

activable.name: Infest
activable.description:
Nearby Ranged Minions deal an additional 100% damage. Can be toggled on or off.

Repeatable Quest: Every 1000 Siege damage dealt increases this bonus by 1%.

Current Siege Damage Bonus: 0%

activable.name: Envenomed Spines

level1.name: Corpse Feeders

level7.description: Gain 2 additional charges of Banelings Barrage, but increase its cooldown by 2 seconds.

level7.name: Viscous Acid
level7.description: Banelings Slow enemies by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

level7.name: Bile Drop
level7.description:
Quest: Passively increases the radius of Infested Drop by 20%.

Reward: After hitting 12 Heroes with Infested Drop, it spawns an additional Roachling.

level13.description:
Every 30 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 50%.

Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

level16.name: Corrosive Saliva
level16.description: When attacking Heroes, Hunter Killers and Roachlings deal additional damage equal to 1.5% of their maximum Health.

level16.name: Mutalisk
level16.description: Reduce the cooldown of Hunter Killer by 4 seconds. Hunter Killer now spawns a Mutalisk. Mutalisks have a bounce attack, lose Health over 42 seconds, and have 450~~0.045~~ Health.

level16.name: Jagged Barbs
level16.description: While on Creep, Zagara gains 50% more Basic Attack damage and her attack range is increased by 1.1.

level20.name: Tyrant Maw
level20.description: Devouring Maw deals 50% more damage. Takedowns reduce its cooldown by 25 seconds.

level20.name: Endless Creep
level20.description: Increase Creep Tumor's cast range from 2.5 to 50. Creep Tumors now last 600 seconds. While on Creep, Zagara gains an additional 10% Movement Speed.

level20.name: Broodmother
level20.description:
Every 3rd Basic Attack also launches a Baneling towards the target.

Passive: Gain 20% bonus Attack Speed.

level20.name: Pack Instinct
level20.description: Zagara and her summons deal 20% more damage to enemies attacked by a Hunter Killer in the last 2 seconds.
